run_create_vasp_inputs_cli: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI to generate VASP input files from a directory of CIF files
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with PBE_54_W_HASH functional and auto kspacing from incar YAML settings
create_input_generator_static: create a StaticSetGenerator with PBE_54_W_HASH functional and auto kspacing from incar YAML settings
write_vasp_input_set: write VASP input files for a pymatgen structure using an atomate2 input generator to a target directory
convert_ase_atoms_to_structure: convert ASE atoms objects to pymatgen structures using AseAtomsAdaptor for VASP input generation
